scenes.statCardReason: Giant Rock Drake boss and gravity-field card.

scenes.title: Hey Ming Phantom Revealed
scenes.storyMoment: Hey Ming reveals a vast black-flame phantom against the Giant Rock Drake.

scenes.title: Blood Marsh Crocodile Rises
scenes.storyMoment: The Blood Spirit Colossal Crocodile rises from a red marsh like a living island.

scenes.title: Crocodile Devoured
scenes.storyMoment: Hey Ming kills the colossal crocodile and devours its life crystal.

scenes.title: Yang Xiao Warns Leaders
scenes.storyMoment: Yang Xiao reports that Chenlin is strong enough to become the alien clans' assassination priority.

scenes.title: Border Breach
scenes.storyMoment: Fallen Clan assassins and Shadow Congregation cultists open a border ritual.

scenes.title: Leakru And Leardis
scenes.storyMoment: Leakru and Leardis lead the Fallen Clan ambush with spear smoke and shadow chains.

scenes.title: Border Officers Hold
scenes.storyMoment: Jiang Wu and Joe Yuan hold the breach long enough for students to withdraw.

scenes.title: Diana Burns Curse Array
scenes.storyMoment: Diana purifies the Shadow Congregation curse array with sacred light.

scenes.title: Leardis Cannot Escape
scenes.storyMoment: Silver Butterfly cuts open Leardis' shadow escape and Hey Ming ends the ambush.

scenes.title: Balian Silence
scenes.storyMoment: After clearing many beasts, Yang Xiao notices the dangerous silence across Balian.

scenes.title: Raging Horned Bull Charge
scenes.storyMoment: The Raging Horned Bull charges through valleys before Hey Ming catches it by the horns.

scenes.title: Undying Bear Rises Again
scenes.storyMoment: The Undying Berserk Bear regenerates repeatedly as Hey Ming devours its vitality.

scenes.title: Three-Headed Serpent Lake
scenes.storyMoment: The Three-Headed Serpent poisons a lake while Diana purifies the water.

scenes.title: Twisted Tree King Burns
scenes.storyMoment: The Twisted Tree King falls during the Balian purge as black flame spreads through its roots.

scenes.title: Dark Gold Bear Flees
scenes.storyMoment: The Dark Gold Berserk Bear tries to flee into the inner mountains.
scenes.statCardReason: Dark Gold Berserk Bear boss target.

scenes.title: Bear Dragged Back
scenes.storyMoment: Hey Ming catches the Dark Gold Berserk Bear and drags it back by the neck.

scenes.title: Wooan Emergency Call
scenes.storyMoment: Wooan Base requests support as beast tides gather under a level 69 commander.

scenes.title: Transport To Wooan
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin boards the transport with academy allies and support teams.

scenes.title: Commander Cao Wu Welcomes Chenlin
scenes.storyMoment: Commander Cao Wu meets Chenlin at Wooan and leads him to prepared resources.

scenes.title: Wooan Resource Crates
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin opens huge crates of rare metals and life crystals for Silver Butterfly.

scenes.title: Lava Edge Upgrade
scenes.storyMoment: Silver Butterfly gains Lava Edge, Sharpness stacks, and Scale At Will.

scenes.title: Wooan Briefing
scenes.storyMoment: Commander Cao Wu orders teams to intercept stragglers and avoid direct colossal contact.

scenes.title: Support Assignments
scenes.storyMoment: Academy support characters receive evacuation, shield, scout, healer, and coordination roles.

scenes.title: Hey Ming Mount Form
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin summons Hey Ming over a hundred meters tall and mounts him with Diana.

scenes.title: Beast Tide Geography
scenes.storyMoment: The Wooan beast tide stretches across the mountain plain like moving geography.

scenes.title: Direct Charge
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin points at the center of the formation and Hey Ming charges the main beast tide.

scenes.title: Commander Cao Wu Protests
scenes.storyMoment: Commander Cao Wu realizes Chenlin is attacking the main formation instead of stragglers.

scenes.title: Black Flame Domain
scenes.storyMoment: Hey Ming unfolds a black flame domain that burns lower-level beasts from within.

scenes.title: Burrower Bait
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin uses himself as bait to mark the hidden burrowing colossal beast.

scenes.title: Diana Rises To Fight
scenes.storyMoment: Diana flies upward and asks to fight despite being newly born.

scenes.title: Diana Transition Form
scenes.storyMoment: Gold light breaks around Diana as she shifts from child angel toward adult moon combat form.

scenes.title: Adult Moon Diana
scenes.storyMoment: Diana completes adult moon combat form with nine dark red ring blades.

scenes.title: Ring Blades Carve Colossal Beast
scenes.storyMoment: Diana's ring blades cut deep wounds into a colossal beast.

scenes.title: Ring Blade Annihilation
scenes.storyMoment: Diana fuses nine ring blades into one enormous annihilating blade.

scenes.title: Colossal Beast One-Shot
scenes.storyMoment: Diana kills a level 65 colossal beast in a single strike.

scenes.title: Diana Reverts
scenes.storyMoment: Diana exhausts her power and reverts to child form, falling into Chenlin's arms.

scenes.title: Wooan Front Cleared
scenes.storyMoment: The western beast front collapses and Hey Ming devours the battlefield remains.
scenes.statCardReason: Growth feedback after major battlefield devouring.

scenes.title: Bear King Awakens
scenes.storyMoment: The real commander, the level 69 Dark Gold Berserk Bear King, rises after the first Wooan victory.

scenes.title: Artillery Fails
scenes.storyMoment: Commander Cao Wu orders artillery, but the Bear King walks through explosions unharmed.

scenes.title: Bear King Targets Chenlin
scenes.storyMoment: The Bear King learns the lifebound weakness and strikes at Chenlin instead of Hey Ming.

scenes.title: Trust Through Fury
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin stops Hey Ming from losing control after being attacked through the bond.

scenes.title: Shared Evolution Warning
scenes.storyMoment: The system offers dangerous shared evolution after Hey Ming is wounded.

scenes.title: Black Flame Armor
scenes.storyMoment: Black devouring flame enters Silver Butterfly armor while Diana's sacred seal keeps Chenlin alive.

scenes.title: Bear King Core Pierced
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin and Hey Ming strike together, shattering the Bear King and devouring its core.

scenes.title: Dawn Over Wooan
scenes.storyMoment: The beast tide loses command and Wooan survives until dawn.

scenes.title: Violet Gate Opens
scenes.storyMoment: The Fallen Clan opens a violet spatial wound over the border defense ruins.

scenes.title: Fallen Sky Phantoms Descend
scenes.storyMoment: Two Fallen Sky Phantoms drift through the gate and suffocate spells around them.

scenes.title: Humanity Assembles
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin, protectors, academy allies, and former rivals gather before the invasion gate.

scenes.title: Lu Ru Yan Apologizes
scenes.storyMoment: Lu Ru Yan admits she was wrong, and Chenlin tells her survival is enough.

scenes.title: Support Network Holds
scenes.storyMoment: Academy support characters coordinate shields, healing, scouting, and evacuation routes.

scenes.title: First Phantom Breach
scenes.storyMoment: The first Fallen Sky Phantom attacks the healer line, forcing Meow Shan Shan and Lia Curly to hold for three seconds.

scenes.title: Phantom Pinned
scenes.storyMoment: Wang Yao, Xiao Yang, and Xiao Yun Shu pin the first phantom until Hey Ming's flame reaches it.

scenes.title: Second Phantom Pierced
scenes.storyMoment: Luolan and Luolu hold the relay as Lu Xiaoyu marks the core and Su Ling Shu freezes it.

scenes.title: Classmates Hold The World
scenes.storyMoment: Ji Kong, Yi Kexi, Lu Hongying, Luwan, and Wangfeng fight across the final battlefield.

scenes.title: Diana Recognizes Crown
scenes.storyMoment: Diana realizes the warlord's bone crown carries the same fallen power that destroyed her sacred tree.

scenes.title: Sun-Moon Awakening
scenes.storyMoment: Diana awakens Sun-Moon Judgment, with gold sun and crimson moon behind her.

scenes.title: Corruption Burned Away
scenes.storyMoment: Diana's sun authority burns corruption from Yang Xiao and Jiang Ju.

scenes.title: Warlord Crown Pierced
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin uses Silver Butterfly to pierce the Fallen Clan warlord's bone crown.

scenes.title: Gate Devoured
scenes.storyMoment: Hey Ming bites into the spatial gate and devours the invasion path itself.
scenes.statCardReason: Spatial gate devoured and final enemy defeated.

scenes.title: After The Gate
scenes.storyMoment: The sky heals after the Fallen Clan warlord vanishes and the alien forces flee.

scenes.title: Sacred Realm Arrival
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin takes Diana to her ruined sacred realm after the war.

scenes.title: Faceless Teacher Statue
scenes.storyMoment: Diana finds the defaced statue of her teacher and remembers her voice.

scenes.title: Gentle Hunger
scenes.storyMoment: Hey Ming eats corruption chains without harming the sacred tree.

scenes.title: Life Crystals Channel
scenes.storyMoment: Silver Butterfly channels gathered life crystals into the roots while Chenlin pours power through the bond.

scenes.title: Sacred Tree Blooms
scenes.storyMoment: The sacred tree blooms with golden leaves and angelic memory figures bow to Diana.

scenes.title: Diana Receives Seed
scenes.storyMoment: The tree releases a gold-silver seed into Diana, completing her restoration evolution.

scenes.title: Years Of Final Hunts
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin's team clears remaining Fallen Clan nests, disaster rituals, and mutant beast kings.

scenes.title: Hey Ming Statue Ceremony
scenes.storyMoment: Yunk Academy unveils a statue of Hey Ming while allies gather.

scenes.title: Family Payoff
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin sees his little sister in an academy-prep uniform and his mother's portrait among honored family seats.

scenes.title: New Disturbance
scenes.storyMoment: Yang Xiao arrives with a tablet showing a new distant spatial disturbance.

scenes.title: Next Horizon
scenes.storyMoment: Chenlin carries puppy-form Hey Ming toward the waiting transport and the next unknown threat.

atomicSceneDefinition: Each scene represents one image-generation beat: a single action, reaction, stat card, transformation, location reveal, or emotional moment.

firstTenMinutes.coverage: First five minutes use the stronger hook block; the remaining dense opening resumes at the quiet Chenlin-Hey Ming bond, then continues through Hey Ming first evolution and the exam transition without repeating the meat-buying, first-feeding, or contractor-feedback beats.

firstFiveMinutes.strategy: Cold open with future payoff, then rapid emotional fall into awakening betrayal and hidden Gluttonous Greed reveal.
